title: Barcode Generator
description: Create standard commercial barcodes instantly (CODE128, EAN13, EAN8, etc.) 100% locally in your browser.
emptyInputError: Please enter a valid string to encode.
invalidEanError: EAN13 requires exactly 12 or 13 numeric digits.
invalidEan8Error: EAN8 requires exactly 7 or 8 numeric digits.
downloadPrompt: If download does not start automatically, click here.

faq.a: We support CODE128 (default), EAN13, EAN8, EAN5, EAN2, UPC-A, ITF, MSI, Pharmacode, and Codabar.

faq.q: Are the generated barcodes vector graphics?
faq.a: Yes! The barcode is generated as a vector SVG element, meaning it can scale infinitely without pixelating or losing print scan quality.
